greeting: ^It is so obvious as to sound almost banal, but that does not make it less true: the Church could not go on without your dedication and pastoral service. So before all else, I would like to express my gratitude and appreciation for the generous work that you do each day.

^In addition to this, your earlier work in the new lands has aided our missionaries. The Shrines are back to their prior state and this is the fruit of your labor. We are extatic to invite you to our great Capital in the upcoming year to celebrate this milestone and your hardwork.
page2: ^There seem to be troubles at the area still but they seem minor compared to what was possessing them. It has come to our attention that vegetation and, forests and crops are dying quicker and the natives are upset. The northern lands have a cooler climate than ours so we are not worried.
^The people might resist but our Script must be passed on to save them. Knowledge is most important to aid our sisters and brothers on this earth.
^All praise the Holy! We greet you brother, take our invitation with a warm embrace.
^the Servants of the Blessed in the year of Lamb
